group.label: Assistant
group.comment: A chat with Claude in the admin (the AI Assistant menu item). It uses the AI provider of Zero > CMS > AI: the Anthropic API (its key) or Amazon Bedrock (the server's AWS role, no key). Who may use it: System > User Roles > Role Resources > AI Assistant; what it may do for them: the role's other resources (products, categories, pages, blocks, orders…). Every change it proposes waits for the admin's Confirm.

field.label: Chat in the Admin
field.comment: No: the AI Assistant page and its menu item are gone for every admin user. The assistant then works only through the Claude connector (Claude Connector below, module Zero_Mcp), where Claude thinks with the admin's own subscription and the store's AI provider is not used (except for bulk product texts). For a store that uses the assistant from the Claude app only.

field.label: Bedrock Model ID
field.comment: Used instead of Model when Zero > CMS > AI > Provider is Amazon Bedrock: a Bedrock model or inference profile id, e.g. us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0.

field.label: Recent Exchanges Kept in Full
field.comment: A conversation's last exchanges (your message and its answer) go to the model in full; the older ones as a short summary, written once the conversation is half as long again. One conversation can then go on for good at about the same cost a message. 10: about 20 messages.

field.label: Keep Data For, Days
field.comment: Messages, uploaded pictures, finished changes (their Undo with them) and bulk jobs older than this are removed every night, and the Claude connector's ended connections too; a conversation goes once nothing is left in it and no live connection uses it. 0: kept for good. bin/magento zero:ai:purge runs it at once.

field.label: Instructions for the Assistant
field.comment: Your store's own rules, added to the assistant's instructions for every conversation. For example: "Write product descriptions in Ukrainian, 3–4 short paragraphs. New products: disabled until checked. SKUs: KK-001, KK-002…". What it can do (its tools, per role) is listed on the AI Assistant page.

group.label: Bulk Jobs
group.comment: Texts for many products at once ("/describe", "/empty"…) are written one product at a time by the consumer zero.ai.bulk, which cron starts (RabbitMQ when env.php has queue/amqp, the database queue otherwise). Each product is one request to the model chosen above.

field.label: Products per Job
field.comment: At most this many products in one confirmation.
